title: 📢 📢 New Feature — CnR Live Status Tracker
body: Hey everyone! 🩸  We now have a live Cops and Robbers server status tracker in <#1531981511845216318> that updates every 5 minutes showing player counts across all servers.  To get yourself tracked when you're in-game, you need to link your CnR username:  Run this command in any channel:  /cnr-link set [your CnR username]  Example: If your in-game name shows as P-B x jamstar, just type:  /cnr-link set jamstar  Use your base username only — no P-B x prefix needed.  Once linked, the status channel will show your name whenever you're online on CnR! 🎮  — Phantom Bloodline Leadership 🩸
